title: Vanilla Pod Frozen Yoghurt
changes_from_base: Low-fat yoghurt is drained only briefly and set with a little gelatine in milk infused with a whole vanilla pod.
summary: A creamy frozen yoghurt delicately flavoured with real vanilla pod seeds. The tiny black specks signal the real vanilla throughout.

ingredients.note: 60 ml to soak the gelatine, 355 ml heated

steps.title: Drain
steps.text: Spoon the 490 g yoghurt into a fine sieve resting on a jug and chill for 1-2 h, until 120 ml of whey has collected; discard the whey.

steps.title: Bloom
steps.text: Sprinkle 2 tsp gelatine over 60 ml cold milk and let it soften for 10 min, stirring now and then.

steps.title: Warm
steps.text: Heat 355 ml milk with 175 g caster sugar and the vanilla pod split lengthways, stirring until the sugar dissolves.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Off the heat, whisk in the gelatine until dissolved. Scrape the vanilla seeds into the milk, whisk to spread them throughout, and discard the pod. Cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Stir the cooled mixture into the drained yoghurt.

steps.title: Churn
steps.text: Churn until thick and frozen; serve it soft, or freeze it in a sealed container and eat within 2 days.

tips: Split the vanilla pod lengthways and scrape out the seeds fully for maximum flavour and visual appeal.
Whisk the seeds thoroughly into the hot milk to distribute them evenly throughout the mixture.
Serve within 2 days of freezing for the smoothest, most luxurious texture.
storage: Store in a sealed freezer container for up to 2 days for the best creamy consistency.
